How it works

  1. 1

    Drop a skill

    Drag a skill folder or a .zip of it anywhere on this page, or paste a GitHub repo that holds one or more skills.

  2. 2

    FastMCP builds the server

    The name and description in the SKILL.md frontmatter become the server's name and description. Instructions, scripts and reference files ship with it.

  3. 3

    Connect your agent

    You get an HTTPS endpoint. Add it to your agent as a remote MCP server, then load the skill the way your agent supports, listed above.

What counts as a skill

A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md at its root. The file opens with YAML frontmatter that names and describes the skill, then gives the agent its instructions. Scripts and reference files sit beside it.

pdf-forms/
├── SKILL.md
├── reference.md
└── scripts/
    └── fill_form.py
SKILL.md
---
name: pdf-forms
description: Fill in and extract data from PDF forms.
---

# PDF forms

Use scripts/fill_form.py to fill a form...
